alexa: @here Production push: Slimline Streaming + Toolchain (hosted) goes live today 16:00 PT. This includes lower p95 routing, safer tool webhook validation, and a smaller memory footprint in the runtime. Docs + migration helper: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/slimline-streaming :tada:
raj: Nice! Any SDK/API changes?
alexa: Minor SDK bumps (js/py -> 0.13.x). No endpoint rename. New tool helpers are opt-in. We provide a migration helper script for batch updates.
deploy-bot: Rollout window 16:00-17:00 PT. Regions: us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Canary keys will tag traffic for telemetry.
sre-bot: SRE will run a short KV-cache exercise during rollout. Auto-pause triggers: streaming-err-rate > 0.6% or p95 > 400ms.
raj: Defaults changing? Rate limits?
alexa: Default concurrent streams per org set to 45 to protect noisy tenants; support can raise limits. Legacy streaming path kept for a 90-day migration window.
eng_oncall: Quick checklist for oncall: 1) watch streaming-err-rate, 2) verify fallback-count in Console, 3) confirm tool webhook whitelists for customers.
alexa: If you spot issues, ping #eng-oncall and tag @deploy-bot. We'll post a short exec note tomorrow with initial metrics.
